feature: Harness artifact consistency and housekeeping for post-v2 state
problem: After the v2 tag and chore-v2-debt-docs, the harness internals are stale: 16 committed/verified tasks still in the active tasks[] array, 2 RESOLVED open_questions still in the active list, 109 breadcrumbs (prune advisory active), duplicate task IDs in the archive (feat-16, feat-15, feat-17), a session-metrics.py docstring making a false ACAM claim, and a direction field that describes a measurement loop that was completed 4 commits ago.
proposed_solution: 1. Run make harness-prune --apply to archive 2 RESOLVED open_questions and prune stale breadcrumbs; if line count still exceeds 50 after apply (age-based retention keeps recent entries), truncate to last 50 lines archiving remainder per prune-harness format. 2. Run python scripts/archive-tasks.py --skip-checks --apply to archive 16 committed/cancelled/verified tasks, leaving only 5 pending tasks in the active array. 3. Fix all duplicate IDs in .harness/.archive/tasks.jsonl via Python line-by-line rewrite: feat-16 line 29 → feat-16-spec-md; feat-15 line 28 → feat-15-eval-guide; feat-17 line 30 → feat-17-r1-commit-hook (later entries keep canonical feat-15/feat-16/feat-17). 4. Remove the false ACAM Advanced claim from scripts/session-metrics.py docstring. 5. Update state.json direction to reflect post-v2 reality (measurement loop complete; pending spikes + feat-eval-measurement-pass). 6. Mark open_question acam_dimension_placement (index 4) as RESOLVED — central mapping table shipped in feat-acam-scenario-mapping — then prune removes it.
acceptance_criteria: state.json tasks[] contains exactly 5 pending tasks with IDs spike-token-estimation, spike-model-selection, spike-token-budget, feat-eval-measurement-pass, chore-v2-debt-harness and zero non-pending entries: python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('.harness/state.json')); ids=sorted(t['id'] for t in s['tasks']); expected=sorted(['spike-token-estimation','spike-model-selection','spike-token-budget','feat-eval-measurement-pass','chore-v2-debt-harness']); assert ids==expected, f'Expected {expected}, got {ids}'; assert all(t['status']=='pending' for t in s['tasks'])" exits 0

.harness/.archive/tasks.jsonl contains no duplicate id values: python3 -c "import json; lines=[json.loads(l) for l in open('.harness/.archive/tasks.jsonl')]; ids=[l['id'] for l in lines]; dups=[i for i in ids if ids.count(i)>1]; assert not dups, f'Duplicate IDs: {set(dups)}'" exits 0 — all three collision sets (feat-16, feat-15, feat-17) resolved

scripts/session-metrics.py does not contain the false ACAM claim: test $(grep -c 'ACAM Advanced Interaction Criterion' scripts/session-metrics.py) -eq 0 && echo PASS-AC3; docstring replaced with accurate description of what the script measures (prompt clarity, turns to completion from breadcrumbs)

state.json direction reflects post-v2 state with measurement loop complete: python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('.harness/state.json')); d=s['direction']; assert 'feat-eval-measurement-pass' in d or 'measurement loop complete' in d.lower() or 'measurement loop' in d and 'complete' in d.lower(); assert 'static ACAM scorer' not in d, 'direction still lists static ACAM scorer as next priority'; assert 'measurement runbook' not in d, 'direction still lists measurement runbook as next priority'" exits 0

open_questions list contains no entries prefixed RESOLVED or DEFERRED: python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('.harness/state.json')); archivable=[q for q in s.get('open_questions',[]) if q.strip().startswith(('RESOLVED','DEFERRED'))]; assert not archivable, f'Archivable entries still active: {len(archivable)}'" exits 0 — includes acam_dimension placement marked RESOLVED before prune

breadcrumbs.jsonl line count is at most 50 after housekeeping: test $(wc -l < .harness/breadcrumbs.jsonl) -le 50 && echo PASS-AC6; make harness-prune --apply run first; if age-based retention leaves >50 lines, truncate to last 50 archiving older lines to .harness/.archive/breadcrumbs.jsonl
edge_cases: archive-tasks.py --skip-checks archives tasks with no evaluator PASS breadcrumb (chore-fix-harness-context-path etc.) — acceptable for housekeeping chores predating evaluator workflow; --skip-checks is intentional

Archive ID collisions (3 sets): feat-16 line 29 (Kill spec.md) → feat-16-spec-md; feat-15 line 28 (Update EVAL_GUIDE) → feat-15-eval-guide; feat-17 line 30 (R1 commit-hook doc) → feat-17-r1-commit-hook. Later entries keep canonical feat-15/feat-16/feat-17. JSONL requires Python line-by-line rewrite, not load-all-and-dump (order must be preserved)

prune-harness default retention keeps max(last-50, within-7-days) — with 109 mostly-recent breadcrumbs, dry-run archives only 1 line; AC6 requires explicit last-50 truncation when prune --apply alone leaves >50 lines
prune-harness --apply archives breadcrumbs to .harness/.archive/breadcrumbs.jsonl and RESOLVED questions to questions.jsonl — expected; archive dir is gitignored
open_question index 4 (acam_dimension placement) resolved by feat-acam-scenario-mapping (tests/eval/fixtures/acam_dimension_map.json) — mark RESOLVED inline in state.json before running prune
verification_method:
Run from repo root:
# AC1: exactly 5 pending tasks
python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('.harness/state.json')); ids=sorted(t['id'] for t in s['tasks']); expected=sorted(['spike-token-estimation','spike-model-selection','spike-token-budget','feat-eval-measurement-pass','chore-v2-debt-harness']); assert ids==expected; assert all(t['status']=='pending' for t in s['tasks']); print('PASS-AC1')"
# AC2: no duplicate IDs in archive
python3 -c "import json; lines=[json.loads(l) for l in open('.harness/.archive/tasks.jsonl')]; ids=[l['id'] for l in lines]; dups=set(i for i in ids if ids.count(i)>1); assert not dups; print('PASS-AC2')"
# AC3: no ACAM Advanced claim
test $(grep -c 'ACAM Advanced Interaction Criterion' scripts/session-metrics.py) -eq 0 && echo PASS-AC3
# AC4: direction updated, stale priorities removed
python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('.harness/state.json')); d=s['direction']; assert 'static ACAM scorer' not in d; assert 'measurement runbook' not in d; print('PASS-AC4')"

python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('.harness/state.json')); archivable=[q for q in s.get('open_questions',[]) if q.strip().startswith(('RESOLVED','DEFERRED'))]; assert not archivable; print('PASS-AC5')"
# AC6: breadcrumbs at most 50 lines
test $(wc -l < .harness/breadcrumbs.jsonl) -le 50 && echo PASS-AC6
